contact-intelligence.reason: Vana team CRM (deal flow, orgs, people, touchpoints). Auth is Supabase OAuth with NO registration_endpoint (verified 2026-09-10 against /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server), so dynamic client registration is impossible and the pre-registered client ID is required; secret is empty (public client). Claude defers the browser approval to first connect. Gemini and Codex are excluded: `gemini mcp add` has no OAuth client-id flag, and `codex mcp add --oauth-client-id` performs an INTERACTIVE login inline (its own help says "for the immediate login only") — with no TTY it hangs forever and blocks setup.sh. Add it to Codex by hand when wanted: `codex mcp add contact-intelligence --url https://contact-intelligence.vercel.app/mcp --oauth-client-id 00565bb9-e53b-4941-b79b-271881f3eded`. Sign in as tim@opendatalabs.xyz; the magic link comes from crm@vanafoundation.org and lands in spam.

codex-cli.reason: Bridge for non-Codex agents; circular/useless in Codex itself.

datadog.reason: US1 site. OAuth login handled per-agent on first connect; no bearer token env var.

pdpp.reason: Grant-scoped OAuth at /mcp (no owner bearer; owner token is REST-only and 403s here). First connect per agent does a one-time browser approval, then reconnects silently.

google-workspace.reason: Slides/Docs/Drive text-level read and write; gog covers slide-level operations but cannot edit text inside shapes.
